description.value: The SandBar Bistro is a seasonal beachside patio restaurant at Long Beach Lodge Resort overlooking Cox Bay on the Pacific Rim Highway, offering casual dining, to-go options, and a fully licensed bar. Its menu is rooted in locally sourced coastal ingredients—fresh seafood, local botanicals—developed by an award-winning culinary team. The dog-friendly patio and sweeping Pacific views make it a distinctive stop for cyclists touring the Tofino corridor.

address.value: 1441 Pacific Rim Highway, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0
